name: GLB-LAB
description: GLB-LAB: Synthetic Library Catalogue Dataset and Reproducible MariaDB Performance Benchmarks This repository provides the research materials supporting the manuscript entitled “Optimizing Grouped Retrieval and Pagination in Legacy Library Systems: A MariaDB Benchmark and Execution-Plan Analysis”, authored by Zouhair Ouazene and Faiq Gmira. The study investigates SQL query optimization for grouped bibliographic retrieval, copy availability, and pagination in legacy library information systems. The experiments were conducted using MariaDB 10.11.14 and PHP/PDO on a controlled synthetic dataset containing 35,510 physical-copy records. Repository Contents The repository includes: A synthetic library catalogue dataset and its MariaDB table schema. PHP, SQL, and Bash programs associated with the experimental procedures. Raw execution-time measurements and aggregated benchmark results. MariaDB EXPLAIN and ANALYZE execution-plan captures. Documentation describing the experiments, their limitations, and the available reproducibility materials. Experimental Campaigns 1. Initial benchmark: 36 workload profiles and 360 paired comparisons between a conventional two-statement retrieval strategy (A0) and an optimized window-counting strategy with delayed projection (B1). 2. Five-variant ablation study: 200 timed executions comparing A0, A1, C, B0, and B1 to investigate the influence of query organization, window counting, and representative-row lookup placement. 3.
